summary: Vox AI, founded October 2023 and headquartered in Amsterdam (with a newer San Francisco office), is led by co-founder and CEO Maurice Kroon. It builds autonomous, multilingual (90+ languages/dialects) conversational voice AI for QSR drive-thru and mobile ordering, designed to operate without a human-in-the-loop during training or deployment, and integrates with existing POS systems without requiring new hardware.

Vox AI raised $8.7M in seed funding (announced August 27, 2025) led by Headline, with participation from True, Simon Capital, and returning investor Souschef Ventures, bringing total disclosed funding to roughly $10M.

The company added an 'Employee Assist' feature giving staff real-time inventory alerts and shift guidance alongside the core voice-ordering product, and reports 'up to a 17x return' from its first deployments at unnamed major global QSR chains via shorter queues and increased upselling. (Scope note: The '17x return' figure and 'major global chains' reference are vendor-supplied and unnamed; no specific customer or independently verified methodology is available.)
